children: may retest a support at $4,257 per ounce, a break below which could open the way towards the $4,156-$4,197 range.
The metal failed to stabilize above a falling channel, after briefly piercing above it. The failure, along with the subsequent deep drop, confirmed a continuation of the downtrend.
Riding on a wave C, the trend may extend to $4,099, the 100% projection level of this wave. Resistance is at $4,306, a break above which may lead to a gain to $4,354.
On the daily chart, the metal has broken a support at $4,306. The break opened the way towards the $4,083-$4,168 range. The nature of the current remains unclear.

The fall might be a continuation of the downtrend from $5,587 or a deep correction against the bounce from $3,943. The general expectation would be that the deeper the fall, the weaker the second bounce, if there is one.
